name: dsh-supercollider
description: SuperCollider for the agent: ten sc_* tools that boot the audio server, compile and load SynthDefs and rewrite a patch while it sounds, five bundled skills that teach the language and the live-coding workflow, and a deliberately small console tab. Zero npm dependencies and no MCP server - one long-lived sclang session and a hand-written OSC client to scsynth.
